provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design)

steps.text: New players: start with the introductory games (Space Diamonds, Starship Builder, Race For Glory)
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) A3

steps.text: Decide on Modules and variants (quick start V1 is recommended for 4+ players)
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C

steps.text: Sol Sunspot Cycle placard on its CORE GAME side; 4 translucent red disks over the Sol icon
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C1

steps.text: Seniority disks for the game length: 4 short (48 years), 5 medium (60), 7 with Futures (84)
steps.ref: HF4A Module 2: Colonization rules 2A2d

steps.text: Module 3 Political Assembly placard: 4 seniority disks on its centre (5 intermediate, 7 with Futures)
steps.ref: HF4A Module 3: Conflict rules 3A2a

steps.text: Deal each player a random Crew; each secretly picks which side to play
steps.note: Norse Astronauts / SpaceX: borrow an unused colour as your grey
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C2

steps.text: Split into Independence and Loyalist blocs (at least 1 player each); each bloc assigns its factions
steps.ref: HF4A Module 3: Conflict rules 3A2b

steps.text: Each player: a playmat with the Crew faceup in the LEO slot
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C3

steps.text: Reserve in your colour: 2 Rockets, 1 Dry Mass and 1 Wet Mass chit, 7 Factory cubes, 7 Colony domes, 9 Claim disks, 2 Outpost chits
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C3

steps.text: Also your big wooden cube for your Freighter
steps.ref: HF4A Module 1: Terawatt rules 1A2

steps.text: Also 2 Bernal figures and 1 extra yellow/grey Wet Mass chit
steps.ref: HF4A Module 2: Colonization rules 2A2c,f

steps.text: Also {n} bribes (black disks) and your dropstone on its playmat spot
steps.ref: HF4A Module 3: Conflict rules 3A2d-e

steps.text: Shuffle the 6 patent decks (thruster, robonaut, refinery, generator, reactor, radiator) separately, White-Side up
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C4

steps.text: Add the Freighter and GW/TW thruster decks, Black-Side up
steps.ref: HF4A Module 1: Terawatt rules 1A2

steps.text: Add the Bernal deck White-Side up; shuffle all colonists into a queue, Purple-Side down (not for auction)
steps.ref: HF4A Module 2: Colonization rules 2A2a-b

steps.text: Aqua beads into each LEO slot: one per patent deck in play (quick start: none)
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C5

steps.text: A blue bead on each of the 6 starting spaces of the Exploitation Tracks
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C6

steps.text: 1 glory chit, 1 VP side up, on each Heliocentric Zone: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Ceres, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C7

steps.text: A heroism chit on each of the 4 heroism spots
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C7

steps.text: Propaganda chits on the assembly: freedom, individuality, equality Independence side up; honor, unity, authority Loyalist side up
steps.ref: HF4A Module 3: Conflict rules 3A2f

steps.text: Each player's delegate on the propaganda chit of their ideology colour (extremist)
steps.ref: HF4A Module 3: Conflict rules 3A2g

steps.text: Use only White-Sides of patents until you build your first Factory
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) B2

steps.text: Remove a red disk each time the seniority threshold is crossed (each 12-year cycle)
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C1

steps.text: Freighters and GW/TW thrusters can only enter the map via ET production
steps.ref: HF4A Module 1: Terawatt rules 1A2a

steps.text: Best clout (A highest) is 1st Player: they put a cube on the Sunspot Cycle start and take the first turn
steps.ref: High Frontier 4 All core rules (Ion Game Design) C8
